summary.name: Storybook Illustration (Drawing and Illustration category, explicit provenance). The source names this as a picture-book style built on illustrated characters and environments.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: recognizable characters in narrative environments, small props, warm colors, optional paper texture and drawn edges. Emphasizes observation, reactions and emotional change, with time to read each scene and consistent character continuity. Medium-specific materials are unspecified.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: picture-book narratives, children's stories and brand fables. Inferred: character-driven stories where expressions and reactions carry meaning. Dense data, precise diagrams or product UI are not named as suitable and would need a separate justification.
summary.limitations: Explicit: paper texture and drawn edges are optional, and no sketch medium is mandated. Rough.js only adds hand-drawn contours and hachure; it does not supply poses, handwriting, paper texture or authentic pencil or ink. Avoid rubbery stretch, visible seams and claims of frame-by-frame animation. Pose count and rig method are unspecified.
summary.palette: Background is scene_dependent; #F6E9CE is only an illustrative swatch, not a required canvas. Choose the background from subject, lighting and mood. Suggested tokens: foreground #493E32, accents #BA7254, #6F8871 and #D5AB55. No approved exact colors were supplied, so this is a style-compatible suggestion. Foreground/background contrast is 8.653:1; accent_1 and accent_2 are decorative only. Gradients are disabled. Recheck composited contrast in every motion state.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: movement relies on pose swaps, local path movement and measured camera moves, with reactions and expression changes carrying emotion. Optional motion references include door-bloom reveal, bounded gaze following, chaptered transitions, scrollytelling and lighting-state progression. Each is used only if the scene supports it. Hover and scroll apply only to interactive delivery; video uses timeline time.
summary.audio: Unspecified in the source, and no audio was verified in the source-frame review. Inferred suggestion: restrained, gentle music or ambience that leaves room for narration, with sound accents reserved for key actions. Silence is valid during reading holds. No audio was created or supplied for this summary; speech, music and effects are optional.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicit tech requirement: layered illustration PNG assets with alpha, consistent dimensions, clear naming and a layer manifest or numbered frames, inspected before composition. Character and background layers need consistent design to support pose swaps. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Source sample mascots and wordmarks must not be copied.
summary.combinations: Storybook Illustration works alone for picture-book narratives. Explicit suggestions: style-101 for parallax background depth, using a shared warm palette, overscan and restrained drift. Style-091 for rigged character poses and expressions, keeping drawn edges and avoiding visible seams. Both need consistent occlusion, proportions and layers, and should avoid fast camera moves.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition, timing, audio sync, validation and export; Remotion is only a documented fallback. Layered PNGs and Canvas 2D form the style renderer. GSAP owns the paused timeline. PixiJS and Rough.js are optional. Chroma-js validates colors. Validate with npx hyperframes check, snapshot and render, then inspect decoded frames.
